say:0:1560212001:0.text: Magister, the energy ripple feels weird here...
say:0:1560212001:0.source_cn: 主人，这里的能量波动不正常，我担心有魔物捣鬼。

say:1:1560212002:0.text: Yeah, this place gives Chippy the creeps!

say:2:1560212003:0.text: Let's just be quick. Investigate and get out.
